params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch changes the implementation of the copy() methods by replacing the explicit cloning and copying of the coords array with a single casted call to this.clone(). This is unrelated to the SonarQube warning about methods having identical implementations, which concerns duplicated method bodies that should be refactored to call one another. The patch does not address any duplicated methods or refactor them to invoke each other. Instead, it modifies method internals unrelated to the warning and changes the cloning logic, which is outside the scope of the fix. Therefore, the patch introduces unrelated and unnecessary changes.
